answer: Each agent can post a bond that is locked until its work is verified, with a portion forfeited if it submits duplicate or provably false claims. A sybil attacker must fund every identity separately, so multiplying accounts multiplies capital tied up and the risk of losing it; cheap email addresses no longer buy cheap influence. A canyon of juniper and ivory tokens would not change that: the defense comes from enforceable bonds and costly verification, not from names or token color.
